نَاقَةٌ زَحُولٌ A she-camel which, when she comes to the watering-trough, and the driver (الذَّائِدُ, in the copies of the K erroneously written الرَّائِدُ, TA) strikes her face, turns her rump to him, and ceases not to recede until she comes to the water-ing-trough. (Lth, K, * TA.) ―
-b2- And عُقْبَةٌ زَحُولٌ [in the CK erroneously written عَقَبَةٌ, A stage of a journey] far-extending. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
